purpose: Static follow-up on remaining protocol implementation; no authentication or model execution

findings.experimental_opt_in: Official API supports disabling experimental methods/fields; AEEP still opts in unconditionally. Version-specific method requirements need review.
findings.inventory: mcpServerStatus/list is server/tool/resource/auth inventory, not proof of command or model-tool enforcement.
findings.retrieval: Pinned RawResponseItem schema includes tool_search_call and tool_search_output. Normalize candidate identities without retaining contents, then verify actual delivery and completeness; schema availability alone is not a runtime observation.
findings.skills: Explicit skill input remains appropriate for qualification. Optional value trials omit forced skill instructions.
findings.support: Upstream experimental support is separate from assessment evidence and production readiness.
